description: Exact sharp Gaussian-weighted orthogonal projection error over ordinary finite-variation data, including every degree, uniquely maximizing jumps, parity plateaus, and the sharp rate.
integrity: The complete argument, analytic identities, normalizations, equality cases and bounded numerical checker are contained in the delivered files. The classical and published prior statements are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional standard Gaussian L2 polynomial projection; real functions of globally finite unweighted total variation without an L1(dx) condition; not tensor products, weighted variation, non-Gaussian orthogonality or pointwise Gibbs error. Historical priority subject to unindexed literature; the displayed proof and finite checker are not independent validation.
title: Median-jump rigidity and parity plateaus for Gaussian Hermite projection error
